says: In next/, the Reflect ban plan's L5 says no disable line for eslint/no-restricted-properties may stand outside the 6 lines the plan names, but L5 is held only by lint, which honors any disable line, so nothing counts them.
proof: In a scratch worktree at 447bf7a, appending '// oxlint-disable-next-line eslint/no-restricted-properties -- planted' and 'Reflect.get({}, "x");' to next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/Patch.test.ts and running node oxlint-plugins/lint.ts on the folder printed no Reflect fire, while the same Reflect.get with no disable line is red.
cost: A later change can bring back any Reflect.get, set or has under a disable line with a reason, and the ban's 6-line ceiling would not notice.
